'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male [[NPC]] Academy Staff located by [[Fangspire Chasm]] Station, [[Resonance Nexus|{{tt|Solis Lens Array|Resonance Nexus}}]], seen speaking to a stranded researcher, '''Enaru'''. 

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Nochard:''' The Research Institute, you say? It's too far to walk from here. I'd recommend renting a vehicle.
:'''Enaru:''' A vehicle, right... Got it.
:'''Nochard:''' But wait, you're not a researcher, are you? Normally, outside visitors to the Research Institute have a dedicated liaison.
:'''Nochard:''' Did yours not get in touch?
:'''Enaru:''' ...Uh, you know what, he did, actually. Told me to wait right here. But I'm getting kinda antsy.
:'''Nochard:''' I see... How long have you been waiting?
:'''Enaru:''' Oh, not long. Just, like, the whole afternoon. Or maybe since yesterday.
:'''Nochard:''' Is he still coming?
:'''Enaru:''' He has to, right? I can't get through the Institute's doors without him.
:'''Nochard:''' What if he's a no-show?
:'''Enaru:''' I guess I'll just have to keep waiting. Until I become a part of the scenery.
:'''{{Rover}}:''' (That conversation took a weird turn.) 
{{Dialogue End}}
